Read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swar
m-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts ar
e being settled in the background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run a
nswers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a p
roject-wide trend. Deterministic and free. Start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swa
rm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findi
ngs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across wave
s. One finding is one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as s
eparate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a findi
ng from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that f
ires again stays `recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md
): Reverses a dismissal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights
/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after requesting insights. **404 means nobody asked**: it is deliberately not an empty `sta
tus: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop cannot mistake \"never requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request
swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generat
ion is scheduled, not done. Poll the GET above rather than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is st
ill `pending`. A swarm run with no generation in progress answers 409: there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tel
l a caller it stopped something it did not.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/requ
est-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and
draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Ju
dge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion jud
ge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server ag
ainst Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the pat
h names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Determinis
tic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/star
t-an-openai-plugin-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against OpenAI's plugin-directory requirements and returns
`202` with a run id. `submissionMode` is required and never inferred: inferring it would read a forgotten package as `mcp-only` a
nd report the package lane not-applicable, turning a missing input into a clean bill of…\n- [Start a Muse connector readiness run]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server again
st Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness has no AI observations, so the body has
no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin directory. The submission-ready verdict stays
`incomplete…\n- [List readiness runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/list-readiness-runs.md)\n- [Read o
ne readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/read-one-readiness-run.md): Lane statuses, coverage an
d the observation axis. The full report (every finding with its citation and provenance) is a separate fetch.\n- [Cancel an in-fli
ght readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/cancel-an-in-flight-readiness-run.md): The executing
node learns about this on its next heartbeat and aborts the run in flight, which matters more than the row's status: the thing bei
ng stopped is traffic to somebody else's server.\n- [Resume a stopped readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directo
ry-readiness/resume-a-stopped-readiness-run.md): Runs again a run that stopped on the server before it finished, which the run det
ail reports as `resumable: true`. The server is graded with the caller's credentials, so only the person who started the run can r
esume it. The run keeps the inputs it started with, and the request has no body. Poll the…\n- [Fetch a readiness run's full report
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/fetch-a-readiness-runs-full-report.md): Every finding, with its class,
provenance, publisher-documentation citation and remediation. AI-derived findings carry `provenance` of `llm` and are confined to
the experience lane as `heuristic` or `manual-review`; they can never decide a lane. `404` when the run has no stored report: it
may be in…\n- [Start a persisted conformance run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/start-a-persisted-conform
ance-run.md): Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and tasks suites and returns `202` with a run id. The target com
es from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL. OAuth is not startable here. Poll the run detail for the verd
ict. Status, outcome, and score are three different an…\n- [List persisted conformance runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/conformance-runs/list-persisted-conformance-runs.md): Newest first. Optionally narrow to one saved server. `pending` counts check
s the run's profile reported but did not score.\n- [Get a persisted conformance run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conform
ance-runs/get-a-persisted-conformance-run.md): Status, outcome, and score are three different answers. A run whose `projectId` is
not the path's is `404`. Per-suite `profileId` / `pending` are present when they have been stored. `launcher` is the label the lau
nching client declared in `x-mcpjam-launcher`; `attribution` is how the platform record…\n- [Fetch a bounded conformance report pr
ojection](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/fetch-a-bounded-conformance-report-projection.md): Failing checks
only, failed before could-not-run, 50 per page. `totalCases` is every case; `totalFailingCases` is the failing population `trunca
ted` is computed from. `pending` on a check means this profile reported it but did not score it. `404` when the run has no stored
report.\n- [Read one check of a conformance run in full](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/read-one-check-of-
a-conformance-run-in-full.md): One check from the run's stored suite reports, with its status, error and evidence. `details` and `
output` are cut at 16 KiB each, and `truncated` says which were. `pending` means this profile reported the check but did not score
it. Check ids come from the report endpoint. `suite` is needed only wh…\n- [Ingest a completed conformance run in one call](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/ingest-a-completed-conformance-run-in-one-call.md): How conformance runs execute
d OUTSIDE the platform (local CLI, GitHub Actions) reach the Conformance history. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typ
ically an `sk_` key). The `{projectId}` segment always wins over any `projectId` in the body. The literal `default` resolves to th
